Let the four-digit number split as \(100a+b\), where \(a\) is the first two digits and \(b\) is the last two digits.

For \(1818\), \(a=18\), \(b=18\). To get the next number, first try \(a=18\) with \(b>18\).

We need \(18b\) to be a perfect square. Since \(18=2\cdot 3^2\), \(b\) must be of the form \(2m^2\).  
The smallest two-digit \(b>18\) of this form is \(2\cdot 4^2=32\).

Thus the next number is \(1832\), and \(18\times 32=576=24^2\).

\boxed{1832}
